reviews.text: My house burned down in Nov 2022. I got Mr. Gordon’s info from another customer that got a bathroom remodel. When I reached out to him he explained everything thoroughly and made me feel get comfortable about a process I was freaking out about. I’ve never been through an experience like this and I didn’t know any contractors. I hired him as my contractor and he walked me through the process step by step. He was always upfront about everything especially costs, which is why I trusted him from the beginning. 4 months later my house is almost complete and I love it even more than before. If you need a contractor, choose Gordon’s remodeling.
reviews.author: Nina Baxter

reviews.text: Our experience with Gordon Remodeling, LLC was extremely disappointing. From the outset, he failed to satisfy even the most basic requests. We could never get an accurate picture rendering of the work to be done before starting, from the architect Clay Gordon recommended. Clay displayed a complete lack of professionalism, leaving subcontractors unsupervised, which resulted in subpar workmanship in electrical, gas, and carpentry tasks. Despite logical concerns, he used wood particle board for outdoor kitchen cabinets, which is completely unsuitable due to weather and fire risks. Furthermore, the covered patio construction was not weight-bearing and would have torn off the back of our house during the first winter storm. Whenever Clay Gordon was questioned, he became defensive. To top it all off, he walked out on the contract after trying to get more money in advance, and left the work unfinished, creating a significant inconvenience. We had to come out of pocket 40% more of the total cost of the project to have a different contractor fix all the issues. We would not recommend Gordon Remodeling, LLC to anyone seeking reliable and high-quality remodeling work.
reviews.author: my08style

reviews.text: I have used Gordon's remodeling to have my roof replaced and fix an interior ceiling leak. The team showed up on time and ready to work. The service and workmanship were both excellent as they went above and beyond to ensure my satisfaction. I would definitely use for future projects.
reviews.author: MS FAIR

reviews.text: Clay and his team are very professional and neat in their work. My house caught fire and the initial contractors scammed me out of so much due to their dishonesty in their professionalism. This is whne Clay and his team showed up and did an amazing job with my house! Clay is very fair, transparent and honest in his work. Thanks to he and the entire team for fixing my house! I am moved in and loving every moment.
reviews.author: patricia greer

reviews.text: They were unprofessional and wanted payment BEFORE finishing the work. I would NOT recommend this contractor for remodeling. They even took several of our construction supplies while we were away when we refused to pay BEFORE the work was completed. While working on our bathroom with the toilet placed in one bedroom, they did not bother to return the toilet to the bathroom when they left!  Luckily, we found a trustworthy contractor to finish the much-needed remodeling for our water-damaged home - but what a nightmare.
reviews.author: CKay Turk

reviews.text: Mr. Gordon is a nice man as are his employees. However, much of their work had to be re-done at my request. Mr. Gordon felt my initial review was unfair, and he pointed out that he repaired many things at his expense. (Of course, I would think errors should be corrected at his expense, but I do not want to suggest he did not try to make things right, and many times he did.) I believe he was stretched thin, and that resulted in some work he might not normally find acceptable; it also extended the amount of time my project took, which I'm sure was longer than he anticipated, as well. I think for some projects he has good crew members, while others require things to be redone. Maybe he is just trying to help them learn the trade. But, it cost him, and me, time and money in the long run.
reviews.author: Angel Morris

reviews.text: DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY! They do not pay their bills and they do SHAWTY UNPROFESSIONAL  work. I was subcontracted for a job on behalf of Mr. Gordon 6 months ago. Work was completed and inspected by city. After much work on my and my companies behalf, we have  only been given the " run around" and haven't been paid. For any of your remodeling projects do yourself a favor and look else where. My name is Brian Langley and I own Langley Welding service in Arlington.
reviews.author: Langley Welding

reviews.text: I HAD WATER DAMAGE IN MY HOME IN JUNE & 3 CONTRACTORS THAT DID NOT WORK OUT & STATE FARM HOME OWNERS ARE THE WORST. IN AUGUST I WAS IN BATH & BODY WORKS MET MR. GORDAN HE GAVE ME HIS CARD THE NEXT DAY SCHEDULED APPOINTMENT HE CAME OUT & GAVE ME HIS ESTIMATE. MY ADJUSTER THOUGHT HE WASN'T LEGIT & SAID ONCE I PULLED UP HIS NUMBER HIS COMPANY CAME STRAIGHT UP WHICH HE SAID VERY USUALLY. AFTER 2 WEEKS FINALLY MR. GORDON GOT THE CONTRACT FROM STATE FARM WHICH WAS CHEAPER THAN QUOTE BUT ANYWAY AFTER 3 MONTHS GORDAN REMODELING CAME SEPTEMBER 28TH & 3 DAYS MY 2 ROOMS & HALLWAY WAS COMPLETE. I LOVE MY NEW FLOORS & WOULD DEFINITELY HIRE & REFER HIS COMPANY. VERY PROFESSIONAL ,POSITIVE ENERGY & HE TREATED ME LIKE HE HAD BEEN KNOWING ME FOREVER WHICH MADE ME HAPPY!
reviews.author: Sonja Kirkpatrick

data.summary: The reviews present a mixed but concerning picture. The negative reviews are highly detailed, credible, and reveal consistent patterns of unprofessionalism, poor work quality, and payment issues. The positive reviews, while containing some specific details, show potential coordination (same-day posting) and some may be from personal connections. The low overall rating and specific, repeated complaints from different customers strongly suggest genuine service quality problems.
fake_signals: Two 5-star reviews posted same day (9 months ago)
Vague 5-star review lacking detail ('Did some remodeling...')
Owner and a person with same last name (Raul Contreras) left 5-star reviews with no text
Several 5-star reviews from customers with similar severe damage stories (house fires, water damage) who were allegedly scammed by previous contractors
authentic_signals: Specific, detailed complaints with names and project issues
Varied writing styles and perspectives in negative reviews
Mix of praise and criticism in some reviews (Angel Morris)
Emotional authenticity in both positive and negative reviews
complaint_patterns: Payment disputes (requesting payment before completion, not paying subcontractors)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent across Google and Yelp, both in the low 3-star range.
